glosses: to bring or transport across a body of water

examples.text: W nocy 28-go Waszyngton przeprawił cichaczem całe wojsko przez cieśninę, zwaną East River.
examples.translation: On the night of the 28th, Washington quietly brought his whole army across a strait, called the East River.
examples.english: On the night of the 28th, Washington quietly brought his whole army across a strait, called the East River.

glosses: to modify a text, to falsify or correct
